title: FloatConverter breaks for values smaller than 0.0001
author: weddige
body_preview: `FloatConverter` uses scientific notation (`1e-05`) when building URLs with values smaller than 0.0001. This leads to URLs, that can not be resolved, as `FloatConverter` does not handle values containing letters (regex: `\d+\.\d+`).
